sentences.en: The company has strict control over its supply chain to ensure product quality.
sentences.zh: 该公司对其供应链有严格控制，以确保产品质量。

sentences.en: There is strict control on the amount of time students can spend on social media during school hours.
sentences.zh: 在校期间学生使用社交媒体的时间受到严格控制。

sentences.en: The government maintains strict control over prices to prevent inflation from getting out of hand.
sentences.zh: 政府对物价保持严格的控制，以防通货膨胀失控。
